card.name: Allergy and hypersensitivity terms
card.fires_on: The word allergy or allergen, often split as ALL + ERGY/ER, and nearby words like sensitivity, hypersensitivity or allergic. It appears where a label talks about a patient's allergy history.

modes.label: Split allergy words
modes.description: The ending piece of allergy or allergens after ALL in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: SOME FORM OF ALL<<ERGY>>, PARTICULARLY TO DRUGS.

modes.label: Sensitivity wording
modes.description: Words meaning allergy such as sensitivity, allergic or hypersensitivity in history or avoid-if statements.

card.writes: It pushes toward allergy-related words such as allergic and peanut.
card.plain: It lights up on allergy and hypersensitivity wording, especially when a label asks about allergy history.
